- How to simulate/implement the "agents" — since we can't call an external LLM API directly in a simple CLI app, we'll need to design them as interactive prompts or simulated AI components.

### High-Level Architecture

The app will be a state-machine-driven CLI application where each "agent" is a guided prompt that either:
- Asks the user questions (Planner mode)
- Requests code input or generates code (Coder mode)  
- Asks the user to review and rate the code (Reviewer mode)
